_comment: Project-level converter configuration. Committed with generic defaults; override per machine with --config <path> or a sibling converter.config.local.json (gitignored). Every key is optional: missing keys take the defaults below.

diagrams._comment: Per-test-case Mermaid flowcharts under _flows/<suite>/cases/*.md are always written. The png block renders each of them to an image as well.

_keys.enabled: true to render images on every convert (or pass --diagram-png for one run)
_keys.scale: device scale factor for png; 2 is crisp on high-DPI screens
_keys.cases: '*' for every case, a glob like 'B2B-5264*', a regex prefixed with 're:', or a JSON list of case names
_keys.renderer: auto (mmdc if on PATH, else Python Playwright + Chromium), mmdc, or playwright
_keys.output_dir: where the images go; {suite} is replaced with the suite name
